name: Englisch
note: Middle English (late fourteenth-century London, the English of Chaucer) words for the block palette, the page, the examples and what exported programs print, and for Blockly's own blocks and menus (blocklyMsg), since Blockly has no Middle English. Spelling is normalised to one consistent form without þ or ȝ; modern words (email, token, API, Home Assistant) are kept. In blocks, keys are block types and the English parts they replace; dropdown values never change, only their labels. In page, starters and python, keys are the English text, with {name} for the parts filled in. In examples, keys are the example keys. In blocklyMsg, keys are Blockly's message names. Page buttons named in block text use their Middle English names (Renne, Go forth, Devyses).

rb_agent.message1: up to %1 pases, with thise tooles:
rb_agent.message3: make first a purpos, and chaunge it as it goth %1
rb_agent.tooltip: Claude demeth what to do next: at ech pas he cheseth oon of the tooles withinne, seeth what bifel, and goth forth til the ende be wonne or the pases be spent. His laste answere goth into the draughte. Ech pas is oon callyng of the patron. Whan “make first a purpos” is marked, he writeth a short purpos with his firste pas and kepeth it newe, withouten more cost.

rb_agent_builtin.tooltip: A tool al redy for the procuratour. “Rekene sommes” and “houres and dayes” yeven nombres and tymes right exactly, in stede of the patron gessynge. “Examyne text” lat another examinour deme the procuratoures werk. In this leef, tydinges streemes, GitHub, Telegram, email and the kalender usen ensample matere; the Python sent out useth thyn owene (put the keyes in second-thought.ini), and redeth web leves in sooth. Sendynge, commentynge and “governe engynes” asken thee bifore ech oon, for that the procuratour redeth (a web leef, a note) myghte assaye to stere hym. Chees “withouten askynge” oonly if thou truste al that he redeth. Unlokynge, openynge and disarmynge asken alwey.

rb_agent_mcp.tooltip: Yeveth the procuratour every tool that an MCP servaunt profreth: quaiers, GitHub, hordes of matere, kalenders and muche more, out of al the MCP world. Sette the servaunt in second-thought.ini as MCP_<NAME> = the comaundement that bigynneth it (as npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem ~/recipes) or his https:// place. Oonly in Python sent out: in this leef the procuratour travailleth withouten thise tooles.

rb_agent_steps.tooltip: What the newest procuratour in this rennyng dide: a rolle of recordes with step, tool, input, result and status (done, bad input, tool error, refused, repeat, not a tool, unreadable, empty answer, stopped, answer).

rb_agent_tool.tooltip: Lat the procuratour renne oon of thy My blokkes. His inputtes bicomen the tooles inputtes, and that he yeldeth is the effect the procuratour seeth. Descryve it pleynly: the descripcioun is al that the procuratour knoweth of it. Kyndes of the inputtes, as “flour grammes: number; water grammes: number - grammes of water”, seyn what ech input moot be: text, number, yes/no, list or any. The procuratoures input is examyned er the blok renneth. “Aske me bifore ech usage” bigynneth marked, for that the procuratour redeth (a web leef, a note) myghte assaye to stere hym: unmarke it for blokkes that oonly rekene and chaungen nothyng.

rb_approve.tooltip: Sheweth the text and abideth til thou graunte it or sende it agayn.

rb_ask_first.tooltip: Fro hennes forth, the devys sheweth what it wol do and abideth til thou yeve leve. If thou seist nay, it passeth that pas and goth forth. The Python sent out asketh in the terminal; a rennyng set by tyme with no man there passeth it.

rb_ask_list.tooltip: Claude answereth with a rolle that thou mayst go aboute.

rb_ask_me.tooltip: Stinteth the rennyng til thou write an answere in the book.

rb_ask_record.message0: aske Claude for a recorde with feeldes %1 : %2
rb_ask_record.tooltip: Feeldes departed by commas, as thus: title, score, notes.

rb_ask_records.message0: aske Claude for a rolle of recordes with feeldes %1 : %2

rb_ask_yesno.tooltip: Claude answereth a questioun of ye or nay.

rb_broadcast.tooltip: Bigynneth every processe “whan I receyve” for this message, and goth forth anon.

rb_broadcast_wait.tooltip: Bigynneth every processe “whan I receyve” for this message and abideth til they alle be doon.

rb_broadcast_with.tooltip: Bigynneth every processe “whan I receyve” for the message. Ech oon geteth the valewe as his “valewe of the message”.

rb_budget.tooltip: Bifore ech callyng of the patron, it loketh how many tokens this rennyng hath spent. Whan it cometh to this nombre, the rennyng stinteth. 0 meneth no lymite. In this leef the tale is a gesse; the Python sent out useth the verray tales.

rb_cal_when.message0: whan a kalender event bigynneth in %1 minutes
rb_cal_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe so many minutes bifore ech event in thy kalender (events of al the day ben nat told). “What cam” yeveth title, start, end, location, minutes and text.

rb_calendar.tooltip: Thy kalenderes events fro this day, as recordes: day, start, end, title, location. The Python sent out redeth CALENDAR_URL (thy kalenderes prive iCal place); this leef useth an ensample kalender.

rb_chat.tooltip: Sendeth a message in a named conversacioun. Claude seeth the eerlier turnes of that conversacioun.

rb_checkpoint_restore.tooltip: Putteth the charge, the draughte, the examinacioun, the effect and the variables agayn as they were at “save mark”. Memorie, quaiers and messages ysent alreedy ben nat undoon.

rb_checkpoint_save.tooltip: Remembreth the charge, the draughte, the examinacioun, the effect and the variables as they ben now, under this name, for the remenaunt of the rennyng.

rb_contains.tooltip: Trewe if the firste text hath the seconde withinne (it recketh nat of grete or smale lettres).

rb_discord_send.tooltip: Writeth in Discord: bak in the chanel a message cam fro, or in the firste chanel in DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID. “Aske me bifore sendynge of messages” maketh it aske first. In this leef it is oonly shewed.

rb_discord_when.message0: whan a Discord message cometh conteynynge %1
rb_discord_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan any wight writeth in oon of thy Discord chanels (write “anything”, or wordes the message moot conteyne). Oonly the chanels in DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID ben told, and the botes owene messages nevere. Loked on every 10 secondes. “What cam” yeveth text, sender and channel. In this leef, clikke it with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye it with an ensample message.

rb_email_send.tooltip: Sendeth an email fro thy place (EMAIL_ADDRESS and an app password in second-thought.ini). “Aske me bifore sendynge of messages” maketh it aske first. In this leef it is oonly shewed.

rb_email_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan a newe email cometh into thyn inbox (loked on every 2 minutes), if his sendere, matere or wordes conteyne this. “What cam” yeveth from, subject, body and text.

rb_error.tooltip: What wente amys in the newest faillynge.

rb_event.tooltip: Withinne a processe “whan … cometh”: oon feeld of that which cam. Every herkener yeveth “text”, that sommeth it al; the tooltip on ech “whan” blok telleth his othere feeldes. Lat it be voyde for al the recorde.

rb_every.tooltip: Renneth ofte whil Ordinaunces ben on and this leef is open. The firste rennyng is oon space after thou turne Ordinaunces on.

rb_feed_news.tooltip: The newest thynges fro a tydinges streem (RSS or Atom), newest first, as recordes: feed, title, link, date, summary. Lat it be voyde for thyn owene streemes (feeds = … in second-thought.ini). In this leef it useth ensample streemes.

rb_feed_when.message0: whan ther is somwhat newe in streem %1
rb_feed_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe for ech newe thyng in a tydinges streem (loked on every 15 minutes). Lat it be voyde for thyn owene streemes. “What cam” yeveth feed, title, link, date, summary and text.

rb_file_choose.message0: text of a quaier that I chese
rb_file_choose.tooltip: Stinteth the rennyng that thou mayst chese a PDF, a Word .docx, or a quaier of text. Yeldeth the quaieres text.

rb_file_save.tooltip: Profreth the text to be fet doun. The web brouser preyeth thee to conferme it.

rb_folder_files.tooltip: The quaiers in a folder, newest first, as recordes: name, path, modified, size. “Lyk” is a patroun as *.pdf; lat it be empty for every quaier. It lokeþ oonly: it redeth hem nat. Exported Python lokeþ in the folder; this page useth ensample quaiers.

rb_folder_when.message0: whan a quaier appereth in folder %1
rb_folder_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan a newe quaier cometh into this folder (bisyde the devys, but if thou yeve a ful wey). “What cam” yeveth his name, wey, gretnesse, and the wordes in it for a PDF, Word or text quaier. For a picture, “picture” yeveth it to the picture blokkes.

rb_generate.tooltip: Claude writeth a draughte that fulfilleth the charge.

rb_gh_issue_when.message0: whan a newe issue is opened in %1
rb_gh_issue_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan any wight openeth an issue in this GitHub werk (loked on every 5 minutes; pull requests ben nat rekned). “What cam” yeveth repo, number, title, body, author, labels, link and text.

rb_gh_release_when.message0: whan a release is published in %1
rb_gh_release_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan this GitHub werk publisheth a release (loked on every 15 minutes). “What cam” yeveth repo, tag, name, previous_tag, notes, link and text.

rb_gh_when.message0: whan a pull request preyeth my examinacioun
rb_gh_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan any wight preyeth thee to examyne a GitHub pull request (loked on every 5 minutes). “What cam” yeveth repo, number, title, user, link and text.

rb_ha_attr.tooltip: Oon propretee of a thyng, as “current_temperature” or “friendly_name”.

rb_ha_call.tooltip: Calleth a servyce, as light.turn_off. Matere at thy wille is JSON as {"temperature": 20}. Unlokynge, openynge and disarmynge asken thee alwey first.

rb_ha_event_when.message0: whan Home Assistant event %1 bifalleth with %2
rb_ha_event_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe in the same moment that Home Assistant sendeth this event: a pressynge of a botoun or a fer-governour (zha_event, deconz_event), an automacioun that firth (automation_triggered), a dede of a phone notificacioun, or thyn owene event. Write “anything” for every event. The seconde box is wordes at thy wille that the eventes matere moot conteyne, as the fer-governoures name. “What cam” yeveth event_type, entity, data, time and text, and ech feeld of the eventes matere. In this leef, clikke it with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye it with an ensample event.

rb_ha_find.tooltip: A rolle of recordes (entity, name, state, unit, area) for every thyng whos id, name, place or estaat conteyneth alle thise wordes. “*” meneth alle.

rb_ha_history.message0: storie of %1 for the laste %2 houres
rb_ha_history.tooltip: A rolle of recordes (time, state) shewynge how the thyng was chaunged.

rb_ha_notify.tooltip: Sendeth a warnynge. The mark is a notify servyce as notify.mobile_app_my_phone, or persistent_notification for the Home Assistant syde.

rb_ha_snapshot.tooltip: An ymage fro a camera thyng. Use it with the Ymages blokkes.

rb_ha_speak.tooltip: Speketh the text on a pleyere, by Home Assistantes text-to-speche.

rb_ha_state.tooltip: The thynges estaat now, as “on”, “locked” or 19.5.

rb_ha_summary.tooltip: A rolle in pleyn text of thynges acordynge and hir estaatz, redy to putte into a questioun for Claude.

rb_ha_trigger.tooltip: In a processe “whan … chaungeth”: a recorde with entity, name, from and to.

rb_ha_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan this thyng chaungeth. Write “anything” to answere to every chaunge. Withinne, “what was chaunged” telleth what bifel.

rb_homey_find.tooltip: A rolle of recordes, oon for ech engyn whos name, place or kynde conteyneth alle thise wordes (“*” for every engyn): name, zone, class, and ech of his valewes.

rb_homey_flow.tooltip: Bigynneth oon of thy Homey floodes, by his name. A flood may do al that thy Homey may, ye, sende a Homey warnynge.

rb_homey_set.tooltip: Setteth a valewe, as onoff to off, dim to 0.5 or target_temperature to 19. “Aske me bifore any dede of the wise hous” maketh it aske first; unlokynge, openynge and disarmynge asken alwey. In this leef it chaungeth the ensample hous.

rb_homey_set_variable.tooltip: Chaungeth a Homey Logic variable, that thy floodes may use it.

rb_homey_value.tooltip: Oon valewe of a Homey engyn, by the engynes name: onoff (on or of), dim (0 to 1), measure_temperature, measure_power and so forth. “Homey engynes acordynge to” sheweth what ech engyn hath.

rb_homey_variable.tooltip: The valewe of a Homey Logic variable, by his name.

rb_homey_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan this Homey engynes valewe chaungeth (loked on every 10 secondes). Write “anything” for any of his valewes. “What cam” yeveth device, zone, capability, from, to and text. In this leef, clikke it with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye it.

rb_img_ask.tooltip: Claude loketh on the ymage and answereth.

rb_img_change.tooltip: Claude peynteth the ymage newe with thy chaunge. A portreiture cometh agayn as a newe illuminacioun.

rb_img_choose.tooltip: Stinteth the rennyng that thou mayst chese an ymage (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or SVG).

rb_img_draw.tooltip: Claude peynteth an illuminacioun as SVG (flat shapes, figures, signes). He may nat make portreitures.

rb_img_save.tooltip: Profreth the ymage to be fet doun. The web brouser preyeth thee to conferme it.

rb_longtext.tooltip: Long text. Presse Enter for a newe lyne; lynes breken at 80 lettres.

rb_mem_add.tooltip: Addeth a thyng to a remembred rolle. If the rolle is ther alreedy it kepeth his owene kynde and ende.

rb_mem_get.tooltip: The remembred valewe, or voyde text if nothyng is remembred under this name.

rb_mem_set.tooltip: Whil this leef is open: kept from rennyng to rennyng til thou newe or close the leef. For evere: kept til thou foryete it.

rb_mem_set_for.tooltip: Kept as “for evere”, but foryeten of itself after so longe (up to 365 dayes).

rb_mqtt_publish.message0: publisshe MQTT %1 to matere %2 kepe it %3
rb_mqtt_publish.tooltip: Sendeth a message to thy MQTT broker. “Kepe it” preyeth the broker to remembre it for any that herkneth after. “Aske me bifore any dede of the wise hous” or “sendynge of messages” maketh it aske first. In this leef it is oonly shewed.

rb_mqtt_read.tooltip: The newest message on an MQTT matere. Oonly messages the broker kepeth (retained) shewen anon. With + or # in the matere, a recorde of ech materes newest message. In this leef it useth ensample materes.

rb_mqtt_when.message0: whan an MQTT message cometh on %1
rb_mqtt_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan a message cometh on this MQTT matere. + standeth for oon degree and # for al bynethe, as zigbee2mqtt/#. “What cam” yeveth his matere and text, and the feeldes of a JSON message.

rb_msg_value.tooltip: The valewe sent with the crye that bigan this processe (or that wook this “abide til I receyve”). In a devys renned by “renne devys”, the valewe that was yeven it.

rb_page_when.message1: oonly the part conteynynge %1 loked on every %2 minutes
rb_page_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan the wordes on a web leef chaungen. Lat “oonly the part conteynynge” be voyde to wacche al the leef, or write wordes (as Pris) to wacche oonly the lynes with hem and the two lynes after ech, so that cryinges and countours elleswhere on the leef be nat told. The firste lokynge oonly remembreth the leef. “What cam” yeveth url, title, before, after, changed (the lynes that chaunged) and text. Leves that nede a brouser to shewe hir wordes may nat be wacched. In this leef, clikke it with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye it with an ensample leef.

rb_pause.message0: stinte til I presse Go forth: %1
rb_pause.tooltip: A place of restyng. Sheweth the note in the book and abideth thee.

rb_prompt.tooltip: Text out of thy book of biddynges (open Devyses to adde biddynges).

rb_rec_set.tooltip: Chaungeth oon feeld of a recorde (moost ofte a variable of recorde).

rb_receive.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe as ofte as this message is cryed. Many processes may herkne for the same message.

rb_reflect.message1: up to %1 roundes; whan it failleth, do
rb_reflect.tooltip: Claude demeth the draughte. If it failleth, the blokkes withinne rennen, and than he demeth it eft. Every rounde the examinour loketh eek that olde defautes ben nat comen agayn. If the roundes ben spent, the draughte with fewest defautes is kept, nat oonly the laste.

rb_result.message0: make an ende and shewe the effect
rb_result.tooltip: Endeth the rennyng. Sheweth that thou haddest added to the effect, or the draughte if thou haddest added nothyng.

rb_result_text.tooltip: Al that was added to the effect, as text.

rb_retry.tooltip: If somwhat withinne failleth in a manere that a seconde assay myghte amende (a broken knotte, a garbled answere), it abideth a litel and renneth it agayn.

rb_review.tooltip: Oon examinacioun. Use “draughte passed examinacioun” and “defautes of the examinacioun” afterward.

rb_revise.message0: amende to correcte the examinacioun defautes
rb_revise.tooltip: Claude correcteth the defautes that the laste examinacioun foond.

rb_rework.tooltip: Claude writeth the draughte agayn after thyn instruccioun.

rb_rewrite.tooltip: As thus: write (draughte) agayn to (translate into Frenssh).

rb_run_program.tooltip: Renneth a devys out of thy rolle of Devyses, as a pas. It hath his owene draughte, effect and variables, and yeldeth his effect. Withinne it, “valewe of the message” is the valewe thou yevest heer. The Python sent out hath a copie of the devys as it was whan thou sentest it out.

rb_say.tooltip: Writeth a note in the rennyng book.

rb_set_instructions.tooltip: Sent with every callyng of Claude after this blok, as a role, a tone or the maner of the hous.

rb_setup_check.tooltip: The same examinaciouns as --doctor, as text: ech keye, pakke and conneccioun it useth, with ok, FAIL or NOTE. It redeth oonly. Oonly in exported Python; on this page it seith so.

rb_show.message0: shewe the draughte in the book

rb_slack_send.tooltip: Writeth in Slack: bak in the chanel a message cam fro, or in the firste chanel in SLACK_CHANNEL_ID. “Aske me bifore sendynge of messages” maketh it aske first. In this leef it is oonly shewed.

rb_slack_when.message0: whan a Slack message cometh conteynynge %1
rb_slack_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan any wight writeth in oon of thy Slack chanels (write “anything”, or wordes the message moot conteyne). Oonly the chanels in SLACK_CHANNEL_ID ben told, and botes messages nevere. Loked on every 10 secondes. “What cam” yeveth text, sender and channel. In this leef, clikke it with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye it with an ensample message.

rb_sort.tooltip: Setteth a rolle of recordes in ordre by a feeld. Lat the feeld be voyde to ordre pleyn thynges.

rb_start.tooltip: Every devys bigynneth heer. Blokkes under it rennen fro above to bynethe. Manye of thise rennen side by side.

rb_stop.tooltip: Ende the rennyng heer. Al that is alreedy in the effect is shewed.

rb_task.tooltip: Setteth what the crafty wit shal make.

rb_tg_message.tooltip: The Telegram message that bigan this processe: his wordes, who sente it, or the conversacioun. Voyde out of a Telegram processe.

rb_tg_send.tooltip: Sendeth a message fro thy bot: bak to the conversacioun a message cam fro, or to TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. “Aske me bifore sendynge of messages” maketh it aske first. In this leef it is oonly shewed.

rb_tg_when.message0: whan a Telegram message cometh conteynynge %1
rb_tg_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan thy bot geteth a message (write “anything”, or wordes the message moot conteyne). Oonly messages fro thyn owene conversaciouns ben told (TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). In the Python sent out it herkneth alwey; in this leef, clikke it with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye it with an ensample message.

rb_timer.tooltip: Secondes sith the rennyng bigan or the orloge was set agayn.

rb_tokens_used.tooltip: Tokens this rennyng hath spent: sent and receyved. A gesse in this leef, exact in the Python sent out.

rb_try.tooltip: Renneth the firste part. If any thyng in it failleth, renneth the seconde part in stede of stintynge the rennyng.

rb_use_model.tooltip: Chaunge patron for the blokkes of crafty wit after this oon. Patrons other than Claude rennen in the Python sent out; in this leef Claude standeth in hir stede.

rb_wait_msg.tooltip: Stinte this processe til another processe crye the message.

rb_wait_time.tooltip: Stinte til this houre (orloge of 24 houres). If it be passed today, abideth til tomorwe.

rb_wait_until.tooltip: Stinte til the condicioun be trewe. Loked on twies a seconde, or every 10 secondes if it asketh Claude.

rb_web_search.tooltip: In the Python sent out this seketh on the quyk web. In this leef Claude may nat walke the web, so he answereth out of his owene konnynge and the book seith so.

rb_webhook_when.message0: whan a web requeste cometh to / %1
rb_webhook_when.tooltip: Renneth the blokkes bynethe whan somwhat (Home Assistant, IFTTT, a short wey on thy phone) calleth http://<this engyn>:8765/bake-done?key=<WEBHOOK_SECRET>. Requestes withouten the keye ben refused. “What cam” yeveth the text sent, and the feeldes of JSON or of the place.

rb_when_time.tooltip: Renneth at this houre (orloge of 24 houres) whil Ordinaunces ben on and this leef is open.

rb_with_any_model.tooltip: Renneth oonly the blokkes withinne on any patron that OpenRouter profreth. Write his name fro openrouter.ai/models, as mistralai/mistral-small or google/gemma-4-31b-it. openrouter/auto cheseth oon for thee. Renneth in the Python sent out (nedeth OPENROUTER_API_KEY); in this leef Claude standeth in his stede.

rb_with_model.tooltip: Renneth oonly the blokkes withinne on this patron, and than goth bak to the patron bifore. Patrons other than Claude rennen in the Python sent out; in this leef Claude standeth in hir stede.

review.title: Cercle of examinacioun
review.desc: Claude writeth of autolyse, examyneth it agayns thy reules, and amendeth what so failleth, up to 3 roundes.
review.tip: Chaunge the charge in the blewe blok and the reules in the purpre oon.

interview.title: Questioune me, than write
interview.desc: Asketh what to write and for whom, maketh a draughte, and werketh it newe til thou presse Graunte.
interview.tip: Answere the questiouns in the rennyng book; sende it agayn a fewe tymes to stere it.

w_email.title: Polisshe an email
w_email.desc: Paste a rude email, seye for whom it is and how it sholde sowne, and Claude shapeth it newe til thou graunte it.
w_email.tip: Assaye a hard oon: chasynge a dette unpayed, or seyinge nay to a favour.

w_story.title: Tale for bedde with a juge
w_story.desc: Writeth a softe tale for a certeyn child, and than loketh that it be mete for the age, stille and nat to long.
w_story.tip: Chaunge the reules of examinacioun, as “hath a ryme” or “techeth sharynge”.

w_longpost.title: First the ordinaunce, than the tretys
w_longpost.desc: Ordeyneth the hedes of the parties, writeth ech partie by itself, joyneth hem, loketh on the flowynge and saveth an .md quaier.
w_longpost.tip: Chaunge the charge to any tretys thou woldest on thy web place.

brainstorm.title: Thynke of manye and chese the beste
brainstorm.desc: Claude profreth 6 titles, demeth ech out of 10, and kepeth the heighest.
brainstorm.tip: Chaunge titles for names, sawes or rubrikes.

w_social.title: Oon thoght, fyve places
w_social.desc: Turneth oon tidynge into a tweet, a writ on LinkedIn, a caption on Instagram, an email and a short message.
w_social.tip: Amende the rolle of places to tho thou usest in sooth.

translate.title: Translate into manye tonges
translate.desc: Writeth a welcome for a web place in Englissh, and than translateth it into Frenssh and Spaynissh.
translate.tip: Adde mo tonges to the blok of the rolle.

parallel.title: Two juges at ones
parallel.desc: Writeth a draughte, and than two processes apart demen it at the same tyme: oon for trouthe, oon for bigynneres.
parallel.tip: Adde a thridde processe “whan I receyve” with another juge.

gemini.title: Claude writeth, Gemini examyneth
gemini.desc: Claude maketh a draughte, Gemini examyneth it, Claude amendeth. A seconde doom fro another crafty wit.
gemini.tip: Gemini answereth oonly in the Python sent out; in the leef Claude standeth in his stede.

w_llama.title: Llama maketh the draughte, Claude examyneth
w_llama.desc: A Llama patron on thyn owene engyn writeth the draughte and the amendementz; Claude examyneth ech versioun agayns thy reules.
w_llama.tip: Llama answereth oonly in the Python sent out (with Ollama rennynge); in the leef Claude standeth in his stede.

w_judges.title: Sixe crafty wittes juge
w_judges.desc: Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek, Grok and GPT deme ech thy text out of 10; thou getest alle sixe domes and the mene.
w_judges.tip: Paste a title, a descripcioun of a ware or the bigynnynge of a tale.

r_brief.title: Brief of enquerynge
r_brief.desc: Departeth thy matere into 4 questiouns, answereth ech, and than loketh that al the brief be evene and trewe of that which is unknowe.
r_brief.tip: Assaye “Is flour of rye bettre for a levain than whit flour?”

r_compare.title: Compare choises
r_compare.desc: Setteth out the good, the harm and whom ech choys suteth, demeth hem, and telleth the beste first.
r_compare.tip: Assaye “thre flours for breed”, “two portable engynes” or “holiday in Cornewaille or in the Lakes”.

r_sides.title: Pleten bothe sydes
r_sides.desc: Two processes bilden at ones the strengeste cause for and agayns, and than a thridde pas writeth an evene conclusioun.
r_sides.tip: Use it on a doom that thou art stoked on.

r_second.title: A seconde doom fro DeepSeek
r_second.desc: Claude and DeepSeek answeren the same questioun apart; than Claude compareth the two and sheweth where they discorden.
r_second.tip: Discordes ben where to delve depper or loke on a welle.

w_gptcheck.title: Claude writeth, GPT examyneth
w_gptcheck.desc: Claude maketh a draughte, OpenAIes GPT fyndeth holes therinne, and Claude writeth it agayn to amende every poynt that GPT reysed.
w_gptcheck.tip: A seconde companyes patron seeth that which the firste is blynd to. Assaye it on a lettre for a servyce.

r_sourced.title: Answere with welles (Perplexity)
r_sourced.desc: Perplexity seketh on the web and answereth with welles nombred; than Claude sheweth any seyinge that the welles bere nat up.
r_sourced.tip: Best for thynges that chaungen: prices, houres of openynge, newe tydinges. In this leef Claude standeth in his stede and may nat seke, so sende it out to se verray welles.

w_worldpanel.title: Thoghtes fro al the world
w_worldpanel.desc: Mistral (Fraunce), Qwen (Alibaba), Kimi (Moonshot), GLM (Z.ai) and MiniMax profren ech a thoght; Claude cheseth the strengeste and seith why.
w_worldpanel.tip: Patrons taught in sondry places han in sooth sondry wittes. Assaye names for a ware, or the matere of a feste.

w_groqstorm.title: A swift rounde with Groq
w_groqstorm.desc: Groqes ful swift open patron casteth out 20 rude thoghtes in the twynklynge of an ye; Claude than cheseth the fyve beste and polissheth hem.
w_groqstorm.tip: Chepe, swift patrons ben goode for plentee; a wys patron is bettre for chesynge. Assaye titles of tretys.

c_openonly.title: Oonly open patrons (Hugging Face)
c_openonly.desc: Gemma 4 maketh an answere and GPT-OSS examyneth it. Bothe ben open patrons, rennynge thurgh Hugging Face, so no Claude is used at al.
c_openonly.tip: Handy to compare open patrons with Claude. Chaunge the patron names in the quaier sent out for any patron on huggingface.co.

r_anymodel.title: Any patron thou wolt (OpenRouter)
r_anymodel.desc: OpenRouteres owene choys answereth thy questioun, than a patron thou nempnest answereth eek, and Claude seith which answere is the bettre.
r_anymodel.tip: Write any name fro openrouter.ai/models into the seconde blok “with OpenRouter patron”, as mistralai/mistral-small or google/gemma-4-31b-it.

r_survey.title: Evene questiouns for a survey
r_survey.desc: Maketh questiouns for a survey, demeth ech for evenesse and clernesse, and writeth the feble oones agayn.
r_survey.tip: Lowe or reyse the boundes of the doom (7) in the orenge blok “yif”.

files.title: Somme a quaier
files.desc: Chese a quaier (PDF, Word or text); Claude sommeth it with dedes to do and saveth summary.md.
files.tip: Assaye a long PDF reporte or the writ of a gaderynge.

r_pdf_notes.title: Notes of studie fro a writ
r_pdf_notes.desc: Draweth the chief poyntes out of a writ, telleth the questiouns it leveth open, and saveth notes.md.
r_pdf_notes.tip: Werketh wel with clerkes writynges and longe tretys saved as PDF.

r_web.title: What is newe on a matere
r_web.desc: Seketh newe tydinges on a matere and remembreth whan thou lokedest last.
r_web.tip: Quyk sekynge on the web werketh oonly in the Python sent out; in the leef Claude answereth fro that he knoweth.

pictures.title: Peynte, deme, peynte agayn
pictures.desc: Claude peynteth an illuminacioun, demeth his owene peyntynge, and peynteth it agayn twies with the amendementz.
pictures.tip: Chaunge what is peynted in the firste rose blok.

d_logo.title: Thoghtes for a signe, the beste kept
d_logo.desc: Peynteth thre thoghtes for a signe for thy name, demeth ech oon, and kepeth the beste.
d_logo.tip: Descryve the felynge thou wolt, nat oonly the name.

d_critique.title: Deme my portreiture
d_critique.desc: Chese an ymage of thy bille, leef or screne; Claude yeveth frendly and konnynge doom and the fyve chief amendementz.
d_critique.tip: Take an ymage of a web leef and assaye it.

d_wireframes.title: Drawe screnes of an app
d_wireframes.desc: Turneth a thoght for an app into his thre moost nedeful screnes, with a simple drawynge of ech.
d_wireframes.tip: Descryve thy thoght in oon sentence, as “an app to kepe the tale of my levaines fedynges”.

d_palette.title: Colours fro a mood
d_palette.desc: Maketh a table of fyve colours with hex codes fro a mood or a place, and than peynteth the samples.
d_palette.tip: Assaye “a bakhous at the dawenynge” or “a tavern by the see in wynter”.

d_icons.title: A set of signes that acorden
d_icons.desc: Standynge instrucciouns kepen every peyntynge in oon maner, so that fyve signes comen out as a set acordynge.
d_icons.tip: Chaunge the maner in the blok of instruccioun: colour, thiknesse of lyne, ful or but outlyned.

d_name.title: Name, sawe and firste signe
d_name.desc: Profreth fyve names with sawes, lat thee chese oon, and than peynteth a firste signe for it.
d_name.tip: Use it for a shoppe, a felaweshipe, a ware or a werk of thy pleasaunce.

l_quiz.title: Make a questiounynge
l_quiz.desc: Writeth fyve questiouns with choises on any matere, with the right answere marked, and saveth quiz.md.
l_quiz.tip: Seye for whom it is: “the Tudors, for the fifte yeer” or “fermentynge, for grown folk”.

l_levels.title: Expowne it thre weyes
l_levels.desc: Expowneth oon thoght for a child of seven yeer, a yong man and a maister, so thou seest it at every degree.
l_levels.tip: Assaye somwhat thou thyself understondest but half.

l_tutor.title: Practise with a maister
l_tutor.desc: A pacient maister asketh thee questiouns oon at ones, yeveth tokenes in stede of answeres, and sommeth up at the ende.
l_tutor.tip: Chaunge the nombre of roundes in the orenge blok “repete”.

l_flashcards.title: Cardes of studie fro notes
l_flashcards.desc: Chese thy notes; Claude maketh eighte cardes of questioun and answere and saveth hem as a quaier of text.
l_flashcards.tip: Any PDF, Word quaier or notes of text wol serve.

l_plan.title: Purpos of studie wike by wike
l_plan.desc: Bildeth a purpos for every wike fro that thou lernest, how longe thou hast and how many houres in a wike.
l_plan.tip: Be certeyn: “the firste thynges of Python, 6 wikes, 3 houres in a wike”.

k_meeting.title: Notes of a gaderynge to dedes
k_meeting.desc: Chese the notes of a gaderynge; thou getest a short somme and a rolle of who dooth what and by whan.

k_cv.title: Shape a lyf-writ to a servyce
k_cv.desc: Chese thy lyf-writ and paste the bille of the servyce; Claude writeth the lyf-writ agayn to fitte, and than loketh that every seyinge be yet trewe.
k_cv.tip: Kepe the reule “every seyinge is in the first lyf-writ”. It letteth any thyng to be feyned.

k_complaint.title: Answere a pleynte
k_complaint.desc: Writeth a warm, trewe answere to a chapman unglad, demeth it for pitee, amendeth it, and abideth thy grauntynge.
k_complaint.tip: Amende the blok of instruccioun to the vois of thyn owene chaffare.

k_products.title: Descripciouns of wares in a heep
k_products.desc: Writeth a shoppes descripcioun for ech ware in a rolle, writeth agayn tho that ben demed under 7, and saveth hem alle.
k_products.tip: Putte thyn owene wares in the rolle.

k_agenda.title: Ordre of a gaderynge by tymes
k_agenda.desc: Turneth the entente, folk and lengthe of a gaderynge into an ordre by tymes with an ende for ech thyng.
k_agenda.tip: Adde “with 5 minutes for questiouns” to se it chaunge.

h_bake.title: Ordinaunce of bakynge, wroght bakward
h_bake.desc: Seye whan thou wolt breed out of the oven and gete an ordinaunce pas by pas wroght bakward fro that tyme.
h_bake.tip: Assaye “Saterday at 10 of the clokke”, and than “Sonday at noon, the kichene is coold”.

h_meals.title: Metes fro that which is in the coold cofre
h_meals.desc: Ordeyneth fyve simple sopers fro that thou hast alreedy, and than writeth a short rolle of byinge for the lakkes.
h_meals.tip: Speke of diete, thynges thou lovest nat, or “nothyng over 30 minutes”.

h_recipe.title: Shape a receite
h_recipe.desc: Paste a receite and seye what to chaunge (make it half, make it withouten flessh, chaunge a thyng therinne); Claude writeth it agayn and loketh on it twies.
h_recipe.tip: The lokynge maketh sure that the mesures yet acorden after the chaunge.

h_dayout.title: Ordeyne a day abrood
h_dayout.desc: Ordeyneth an esy day with tymes and places, and than loketh that the tymes of goynge ben trewe and no man left out.
h_dayout.tip: Speke of who cometh: “eldres and a litel child” chaungeth al.

a_bake.title: Procuratour: ordeyne my bakynge
a_bake.desc: A procuratour that demeth his owene pases: he loketh on his notes of thy levain, asketh thee that he nedeth, saveth that he lerneth, and than writeth a purpos of bakynge.
a_bake.tip: Renne it twies: the seconde tyme he remembreth thyne answeres. Adde the tool “seke on the web”, or chaunge the ende.

a_tool.title: Procuratour with thyn owene tool
a_tool.desc: Yeveth a procuratour oon of thy My blokkes as a tool: a rekenere of water. He asketh thee the weightes, useth the rekenere, and expowneth the effect.
a_tool.tip: Make thyn owene My blok that yeldeth a valewe, and than adde a blok “tool: My blok” for it with a cleer descripcioun.

a_timetable.title: Procuratour: tables of bakynge
a_timetable.desc: Telle hym whan thou wolt breed out of the oven. He asketh how warm thy kichene is, and than werketh bakward with the tool of houres, so every tyme in the purpos acordeth.
a_timetable.tip: Answere with a day and an houre, as “Saterday 11:00”. Than assaye to aske for two loves.

a_scale.title: Procuratour: mesure a receite
a_scale.desc: Yeve hym a receite and how muche dowgh thou wolt. He rekeneth the bakeres hundredes and the newe weightes with the tool of sommes, so no nombre is gessed.
a_scale.tip: Assaye “thre loves of 900 g”. The procuratoures somme sheweth every somme he dide.

a_selfcheck.title: Procuratour: write, examyne, amende
a_selfcheck.desc: Writeth a short werk, lat an examinour apart examyne it agayns thy reules, and amendeth what so the examinour fyndeth til it passe.
a_selfcheck.tip: Putte the maner of thyn hous in the reules. The examinour seeth oonly the text, nat how the procuratour cam therto.

a_readfile.title: Procuratour: loke on my quaier of receite
a_readfile.desc: Asketh thee for a quaier of receite (PDF, Word or text), redeth it, rekeneth the water and the salt with the tool of sommes, and sheweth what so semeth wrong.
a_readfile.tip: Any receite with weightes in grammes werketh. A scanned PDF werketh nat: it holdeth ymages of leves, nat wordes.

a_research.title: Procuratour: enquerynge with welles
a_research.desc: Seketh, redeth his welles with good entente, saveth the chief thynges for another tyme, and answereth with the places he used. The Python sent out redeth the verray leves; this leef seketh fro Claudes konnynge.
a_research.tip: Chaunge the questioun. Renne it agayn and he may bigynne fro the thynges he saved.

a_house.title: Procuratour: lokynge on the hous
a_house.desc: Loketh aboute thy Home Assistant for dores left open, feble batailles, engynes gon out of knotte and straunge hetes, and telleth what nedeth heede. In this leef it useth the ensample hous.
a_house.tip: In the Home Assistant table, open first a wyndowe and se if he aperceyve it.

a_bedtime.title: Procuratour: rounde at bedde tyme
a_bedtime.desc: Fyndeth lightes yet brennynge and quencheth hem, askynge thee bifore ech oon. He loketh eek on the dores and lokkes, but oonly telleth of hem: he nevere openeth ne unloketh any thyng. In this leef it useth the ensample hous.
a_bedtime.tip: Seye “Do it nat” to oon of his askynges and se hym go forth withouten that light.

a_news.title: Procuratour: gaderynge of tydinges
a_news.desc: Redeth thy tydinges streemes, passeth over that he shewed thee last, and cheseth that which is worthy of thyn heede, with lynkes. In this leef he redeth two ensample streemes.
a_news.tip: In the Python sent out, putte thyn owene streemes in second-thought.ini (feeds = …). Renne it twies: the seconde tyme he sheweth oonly that which is newe.

a_trip.title: Procuratour: ordeynour of viages
a_trip.desc: Asketh whider thou woldest go and who cometh, fyndeth free dayes in thy kalender, enquereth of thynges, and bildeth a purpos day by day with tymes that acorden and a rude cost.
a_trip.tip: Seye who cometh and what so mattereth, as “entree withouten steyres” or “a litel child”. He saveth the purpos so that thou mayst aske for chaunges another tyme.

a_prs.title: Procuratour: pull requests for me
a_prs.desc: Fyndeth the GitHub pull requests that abiden thyn examinacioun, redeth ech oon, and telleth thee what it chaungeth, what to loke on narwe, and a comente profred. He oonly redeth: he writeth nothyng.
a_prs.tip: Nedeth GITHUB_TOKEN in the Python sent out. Renne it every morwe, or putte it under a blok “whan it is 09:00”.

a_prreview.title: Procuratour: examyne and comente on a pull request
a_prreview.desc: Asketh which pull request to examyne, redeth it, maketh a draughte of a comente, lat an examinour apart loke that the comente be evene and certeyn, and than writeth it, askynge thee first.
a_prreview.tip: Seye “Do it nat” whan he asketh to write, to rede the comente withouten writynge it.

a_inbox.title: Procuratour: sortynge of the inbox
a_inbox.desc: Redeth thyne emails of the laste two dayes, sorteth hem into nedeth answere, worth the knowynge and lat be, loketh in thy kalender for any thyng with a day, and maketh draughtes of the answeres. He sendeth nothyng withouten askynge thee.
a_inbox.tip: Nedeth EMAIL_ADDRESS and an app password in the Python sent out. Seye “Yeve leve” to sende a draughte of answere, or “Do it nat” to kepe it as a draughte.

a_week.title: Procuratour: ordeyne my wike
a_week.desc: Loketh on thy kalender for the wike, thy newe emails and the notes thou hast sent thy Telegram bot, and profreth whan to bake and what nedeth doynge, with tymes that fitten aboute al the remenaunt.
a_week.tip: Sende thy bot notes to thyself thurgh the wike, as “bye flour of rye”. The procuratour gadereth hem.

a_tgbot.title: A Telegram bot that answereth
a_tgbot.desc: Whan thou sendest a message to thy Telegram bot, a procuratour answereth, usynge thy kalender, thy notes and sommes, and sendeth the answere bak. Presse Renne to assaye it with a message writen; in the Python sent out, renne it by ordinaunce and it answereth verray messages.
a_tgbot.tip: In the Python sent out: make a bot with @BotFather, putte the token in second-thought.ini, and than renne run-on-schedule. It answereth oonly thyn owene conversacioun (TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID).

a_discord.title: A Discord bot that answereth questiouns of bakynge
a_discord.desc: Whan any wight asketh a questioun in thy Discord chanel, a procuratour answereth it, doynge any sommes with the rekenere, and answereth in the same chanel. Presse Renne to assaye it with a questioun thou writest.
a_discord.tip: In the Python sent out: make a Discord bot with the Message Content intent, putte his token and thy chanels id in second-thought.ini, and than renne run-on-schedule. It redeth oonly the chanels thou tellest. Chaunge the rose blokkes for the Slack oones to use Slack in stede.

a_linkedin.title: Procuratour: fynde folk on LinkedIn
a_linkedin.desc: Seketh LinkedIns commune leves for folk and companyes on a matere, and telleth who they ben, what they doon and why they myghte be worth to speke with. He fyndeth oonly that LinkedIn sheweth to alle, thurgh a sekynge on the web.
a_linkedin.tip: Chaunge the matere and the place. The Python sent out seketh in sooth; this leef answereth fro Claudes konnynge.

a_mqtt.title: Procuratour: loke on the feleres (MQTT)
a_mqtt.desc: Redeth thy MQTT feleres (Zigbee2MQTT and othere), sheweth any thyng straunge, as a lekynge, a feble bataille or a plugge left on, and profreth to quenche thynges, askynge thee first.
a_mqtt.tip: Python sent out: sette MQTT_HOST. Chaunge the materes in the ende to where thyne engynes publisshen.

y_goodnight.title: Procuratour: Homey, good nyght
y_goodnight.desc: A procuratour loketh aboute thy Homey: quencheth lightes left brennynge (askynge thee first, and leevynge the light of the steyre), loketh on dores and lokkes and oonly telleth of hem, and telleth thee of feble batailles. In this leef it useth an ensample hoom.
y_goodnight.tip: Python sent out: sette HOMEY_URL and HOMEY_API_KEY. Seye “Do it nat” to oon of his askynges and he goth forth withouten it.

y_washer.title: Homey: the waisshynge is doon
y_washer.desc: Wacheth the myght of the waisshynge engyn thurgh Homey. Whan it falleth under 5 W, Claude writeth a short remembraunce and sendeth it to Telegram. Presse Renne to assaye it with a myght thou writest.
y_washer.tip: Chaunge the engynes name to thyn owene plugge. The Python sent out loketh every 10 secondes whil it renneth by ordinaunce.

y_proofer.title: Homey: kepe the risynge cheste right
y_proofer.desc: Redeth the hete of the risynge cheste fro Homey and, if it be to warm, quencheth his hetynge plugge and telleth thee why. To coold, and he kyndleth it.
y_proofer.tip: Chaunge the engynes names to thyne. Adde a blok “whan Homey engyn … chaungeth” to renne it as ofte as the hete chaungeth.

y_energy.title: Homey: whider goth the myght?
y_energy.desc: Redeth every Homey engyn that meteth myght and lat Claude expowne, in pleyn Englissh, what useth moost and what to quenche.
y_energy.tip: Renne it at even, whan moost thynges sholde be of.

y_bakeday.title: Homey: bigynne the maner of bakynge
y_bakeday.desc: Telleth this wikes loves in a Homey variable, bigynneth thy flood “Maner of bakynge”, and telleth thee what thy Homey wol do. Thy floodes may than use the variable.
y_bakeday.tip: Make a flood cleped “Maner of bakynge” in Homey, and a nombre variable cleped “Loves this wike”.

h_gifts.title: Thoghtes of yiftes withinne a cost
h_gifts.desc: Profreth sixe yiftes sorted by pris, lat thee chese oon, and than writeth a message on a carde for it.
h_gifts.tip: Yeve a cost and a fewe thynges they loven.

h_photo.title: What is in this portreiture?
h_photo.desc: Chese a portreiture of a plaunte, the crumme of a loof, a disshe or an engyn; Claude nempneth it and yeveth profitable counseils.
h_photo.tip: Assaye a portreiture of thy loves crumme and aske what it seith of the fermentynge.

c_review.title: Examyne som code
c_review.desc: Chese a quaier of code; Claude telleth his errours and perils, the gretteste first, and than writeth a bettre versioun.
c_review.tip: Werketh with Python, JavaScript, shell writes and moost othere tonges.

c_explain.title: Expowne code pleynly
c_explain.desc: Chese a quaier of code; Claude expowneth what it dooth, partie by partie, for oon that nevere made a devys.
c_explain.tip: Handy for writes thou hast copied fro the web.

c_csv.title: Insightes fro a table of nombres
c_csv.desc: Chese a CSV quaier; Claude fyndeth the fyve moost profitable insightes, with the preves and why ech mattereth.
c_csv.tip: Sende any table out as CSV first (File, Save as, CSV).

c_tests.title: Thynke of cases to preve
c_tests.desc: Descryve a thyng; Claude telleth eighte cases to preve, ye, the harde cases at the egge that folk foryeten.
c_tests.tip: Descryve a verray thyng: “a fourme that taketh a postcode of Engelond”.

x_tgbrief.title: Morwe tidynges on Telegram
x_tgbrief.desc: On werkdayes at 07:15, redeth this dayes kalender and thy tydinges streemes, writeth a short tidynge, and sendeth it thee on Telegram. Presse Renne to assaye it now.
x_tgbrief.tip: Python sent out: putte thy botes token, conversacioun id, kalender place and streemes in second-thought.ini, and than use run-on-schedule.

x_newsmail.title: Email me a gaderynge of tydinges
x_newsmail.desc: Redeth thy tydinges streemes, writeth a gaderynge of that which is worth redynge, and sendeth it thee by email. In this leef the streemes and the email ben ensamples.
x_newsmail.tip: Chaunge the place in the blok “sende email” to thyn owene, and adde a blok “whan it is …” to sende it every wike.

x_mqtt.title: Risynge cheste to warm? (MQTT)
x_mqtt.desc: Herkneth to an MQTT felere of hete. If the risynge cheste go over 26°C, he quencheth the hetere over MQTT and telleth thee on Telegram. Presse Renne to assaye it with a hete thou writest.
x_mqtt.tip: Python sent out: sette MQTT_HOST in second-thought.ini and renne it by ordinaunce. Chaunge the materes to thyn owene feleres (zigbee2mqtt/… for Zigbee2MQTT).

x_webhook.title: Whan the breed is doon (web requeste)
x_webhook.desc: Abideth a web requeste, as fro a Home Assistant automacioun whan the oven is quenched, and than sendeth thee a counseil of coolynge on Telegram. Presse Renne to assaye it with text thou writest.
x_webhook.tip: Python sent out: sette WEBHOOK_SECRET, renne it by ordinaunce, and lat Home Assistant calle http://<this engyn>:8765/bake-done?key=<thy secree>.

x_mailwatch.title: Whan the flour shoppe writeth
x_mailwatch.desc: Wacheth thyn inbox for emails that speken of flour, cheseth the day of bryngynge, and telleth thee on Telegram. Presse Renne to assaye it with an email thou pastest.
x_mailwatch.tip: Chaunge “flour” to thy shoppes name. The Python sent out loketh in thyn inbox every 2 minutes whil it renneth by ordinaunce.

x_feedwatch.title: Telle me whan a streem writeth somwhat profitable
x_feedwatch.desc: Loketh on thy tydinges streemes every 15 minutes. Whan somwhat newe appereth, Claude demeth whether it be worth thy tyme, and oonly than sendeth it to Telegram.
x_feedwatch.tip: Chaunge the questioun to acorde with that thou carest for.

x_folder.title: Turne receites cast in a folder
x_folder.desc: Wacheth a folder. Cast in a receite (PDF, Word or text) and he writeth it agayn in grammes and °C with bakeres hundredes, and saveth the effect. Presse Renne to assaye it with a receite thou pastest.
x_folder.tip: The Python sent out maketh the folder “recipes-in” bisyde the devys. Effectes goon into the folder of outcomes.

x_review.title: Whan any wight asketh my examinacioun (GitHub)
x_review.desc: Whan a GitHub pull request asketh thyn examinacioun, a procuratour redeth it and sendeth thee a somme of thre lynes on Telegram.
x_review.tip: Python sent out: GitHub is loked on every 5 minutes whil the devys renneth by ordinaunce.

x_soon.title: A remembraunce bifore ech event
x_soon.desc: Fiftene minutes bifore ech event in thy kalender, sendeth thee a remembraunce on Telegram with a profitable counseil.
x_soon.tip: Chaunge 15 to as muche warnynge as thou wolt.

x_pagewatch.title: Telle me whan the pris of flour chaungeth
x_pagewatch.desc: Loketh on a shoppes leef every houre, wacchynge oonly the pris. Whan it chaungeth, Claude seith in a lyne whether it be worth to bye now, and sendeth it to Telegram. Presse Renne to assaye it with a chaunge thou writest.
x_pagewatch.tip: Putte thyn owene shoppes place in the rose blok, and the word bisyde the pris (as Price) in “oonly the part conteynynge”. Clikke the rose blok with the right hond and chees Renne this processe to assaye it with an ensample leef.

memory.title: A fresshe title every rennyng
memory.desc: Remembreth every title he hath used, so that ech rennyng (or ech day set by ordinaunce) cometh up with a newe oon.
memory.tip: Open the Memorie table after a fewe rennynges to se what he hath kept.

a_weekly.title: Fryday reporte fro dayes notes
a_weekly.desc: Ech day, renne it and write what thou didest. At 16:30 on a Fryday he turneth the wikes notes into a reporte and saveth it.
a_weekly.tip: Turne Ordinaunces on and lat the leef be open on Fryday after noon, or sende it out to Python.

a_morning.title: Morwe tidynge at 7:45
a_morning.desc: On werkday morwes he writeth a short tidynge: a counseil of bakynge, a word of the day and somwhat to loke forward to. He assayeth agayn if Claude stomble.
a_morning.tip: Presse Renne to assaye it now; turne Ordinaunces on for the verray thyng.

a_batch.title: Do a rolle of werkes at ones
a_batch.desc: Sendeth ech werk in a rolle to his owene processe so they rennen alle at the same tyme, and than abideth til every oon be doon.
a_batch.tip: Adde werkes to the rolle; they yet ende in aboute the tyme of oon.

ha_write_automation.title: Write an automacioun
ha_write_automation.desc: Descryve what thou wolt in pleyn Englissh; Claude writeth the automaciouns YAML, examyneth it agayns Home Assistantes manere of now, and abideth thy grauntynge.
ha_write_automation.tip: Assaye “kyndle the porche light at the sonne goynge doun if any be at hoom, quenche it at 23:00”.

ha_explain_automation.title: Expowne an automacioun
ha_explain_automation.desc: Paste the YAML of an automacioun thou foundest on the web; Claude expowneth it lyne by lyne, and than seith in oon sentence what it dooth.
ha_explain_automation.tip: Paste a blueprint eek: it werketh the same wise.

ha_debug.title: Why ran nat myn automacioun?
ha_debug.desc: Paste the automacioun and what bifel (or his trace); Claude telleth the likly causes and remedies, the moost likly first.
ha_debug.tip: The trace is under Settings, Automations, and than the thre poyntes on thyn automacioun.

ha_dashboard.title: Devyse a table of governaunce
ha_dashboard.desc: Descryve thy chambres and engynes; Claude devyseth the shap of a table and writeth the YAML of the cardes, and than loketh that it be clene and good to use on a phone.
ha_dashboard.tip: Seye who useth it: “for the children” or “a table on the wal of the kichene”.

ha_names.title: Make clene the names of thynges
ha_names.desc: Paste a medled rolle of ids of thynges; gete newe ids that acorden, frendly names and places profred.
ha_names.tip: Copie the rolle fro Settings, Entities.

ha_mesh.title: Ordeyne a Zigbee net
ha_mesh.desc: Telle thy Zigbee or Z-Wave engynes and where they ben; gete counseil where to sette the routeres so the net dwelleth stedefast.
ha_mesh.tip: Seye which engynes taken myght fro the wal: plugges and lampes doon moost ofte as routeres.

ha_buy.title: Which felere shal I bye?
ha_buy.desc: Seye what thou nedest to fele; Claude compareth kyndes of engynes that suten and setteth hem in ordre.
ha_buy.tip: Assaye “moistnesse in the bath chambre” or “knowe whan the lettres comen”.

ha_morning.title: Morwe tidynge
ha_morning.desc: At 07:15 (or whan thou pressest Renne): weder, binnes, kalender, who is at hoom and any thyng left brennynge al nyght, in oon frendly paragraf. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_morning.tip: Chaunge the tyme on the yelwe blok, or speke it on a spekere.

ha_goodnight.title: Lokynge at nyght
ha_goodnight.desc: Loketh on dores, wyndowes, lokkes and lightes, telleth in pleyn Englissh what so is nat right, and than profreth to loke up and quenche the lightes. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_goodnight.tip: Renne it fro thy phone at bedde tyme, or adde an ordinaunce at 22:30.

ha_leaving.title: Leevynge hoom
ha_leaving.desc: Whan the laste wight goth out, quencheth any lightes yet brennynge and telleth thee what he quenched. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_leaving.tip: In the Home Assistant table, chaunge person.alex to not_home to assaye it.

ha_welcome.title: Somme of welcome hoom
ha_welcome.desc: Whan thou comest hoom, sommeth what bifel whil thou were out: dores, mevynge and thynges brought. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_welcome.tip: Chaunge person.alex to home in the table to assaye it.

ha_remote.title: A fer botoun bigynneth the coffee
ha_remote.desc: Herkneth for Home Assistant events. Whan the Kichene fer-governoures botoun “on” is pressed, kyndleth the coffee engyn and leveth a note; his botoun “off” quencheth it. Answereth anon, withouten lokynge agayn and agayn. Presse Renne to assaye it with a botoun thou writest. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_remote.tip: Or clikke the blok “whan Home Assistant event” with the right hond and chees “Renne this processe” to assaye an ensample pressynge. Chaunge “kitchen remote” to thy fer-governoures name, and zha_event to deconz_event or hue_event if that is what thy fer-governour sendeth (Developer tools → Events in Home Assistant sheweth hem).

ha_holiday.title: Lightes for the holiday
ha_holiday.desc: Ech even whil thou art awey, Claude cheseth lightes to kyndle, after how the hous was used in sooth the wike bifore. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_holiday.tip: Oonly lightes may be chosen: the devys loketh that every id bigynne with “light.”.

ha_weekly.title: Reporte of the hous every wike
ha_weekly.desc: On Sonday at even: myght, hetes, batailles and any thyng straunge, as a short reporte saved to a quaier. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_weekly.tip: Presse Renne on any day to se this wikes reporte now.

ha_private.title: Prive tidynge, kept at hoom
ha_private.desc: A Llama patron on thyn owene engyn redeth al the hous and writeth the tidynge, so the matere of thyn hous nevere leveth hoom. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_private.tip: Renne it on the same engyn as Ollama, bisyde Home Assistant.

ha_ask.title: Aske the hous
ha_ask.desc: Aske what thou wolt (“Is any wight at hoom?”, “Lefte I the oven brennynge?”). Claude answereth usynge oonly thy Home Assistant redynges. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_ask.tip: Claude seith so if the redynges holden nat the answere.

ha_bins.title: Remembraunce of the day of binnes
ha_bins.desc: At 19:00, loketh whether the binnes goon out tomorwe (with heede to chaunges for holy dayes) and remembreth thee which. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_bins.tip: Sette it on thyn owene felere of the gaderynge of binnes.

ha_doorbell.title: Who is at the dore?
ha_doorbell.desc: Whan the dore belle ryngeth, Claude loketh on the camera and telleth thee who or what is there, ye, bundels. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_doorbell.tip: In the table, chaunge binary_sensor.doorbell to on to rynge it.

ha_parcel.title: A bundel left withoute?
ha_parcel.desc: At 18:00, loketh on the camera of the fore dore and remembreth thee if a bundel sitte yet on the steppe. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_parcel.tip: Meve the tyme to whan thou comest hoom moost ofte.

ha_motion.title: Wiser warnynges of mevynge
ha_motion.desc: Whan the gardyns camera seeth mevynge, Claude loketh on the ymage and warneth thee oonly for folk or cartes, nat for cattes or bushes that shaken. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_motion.tip: Chaunge binary_sensor.motion_garden to off and than on in the table.

ha_car.title: Is that oure carte?
ha_car.desc: Whan somwhat meveth on the drive, Claude descryveth the carte and compareth it with that he remembreth as thyn. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_car.tip: The firste rennyng remembreth thy carte; later rennynges comparen with it.

ha_garage.title: Is the carte hous shet in sooth?
ha_garage.desc: At 22:00, compareth the felere of the carte hous dore with that the camera sheweth, and warneth thee if they discorden. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_garage.tip: Good for dores whos feleres somtyme sticken.

ha_overnight.title: Gaderynge of the nyght
ha_overnight.desc: At 07:00, oon stille somme of al that the dores and feleres of mevynge aperceyved al nyght, in stede of an heep of warnynges. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_overnight.tip: Adde mo feleres to the questioun.

ha_newdevice.title: A newe engyn on the net
ha_newdevice.desc: Whan an unknowe engyn joyneth the net, Claude expowneth what it myghte be and what to loke on. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_newdevice.tip: Useth the UniFi knottes felere of newe clientes; shape it to thyn.

ha_cheap.title: Renne engynes whan myght is chepe
ha_cheap.desc: Ordeyneth whan to renne the disshe wassher, the waisshynge engyn and the cartes chargere, fro the tariff, the chepeste tyme and the forecast of the sonne, with a cause for ech. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_cheap.tip: Adde thyne owene engynes to the questioun.

ha_bill.title: Why was yesterday dere?
ha_bill.desc: Compareth the use of myght with the weder and with who was at hoom, and expowneth in pleyn Englissh why it wente up or doun. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_bill.tip: Aske it every morwe for a wike to aspye patrons.

ha_standby.title: Huntynge of idel myght
ha_standby.desc: Loketh on every redynge of myght and sheweth engynes that likly wasten myght abidynge idel. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_standby.tip: Renne it late at nyght, whan al sholde be of.

ha_energy_report.title: Reporte of myght with thre sparynges
ha_energy_report.desc: A somme of myght in pleyn Englissh with thre profitable weyes to spare silver, saved as a quaier. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_energy_report.tip: Renne it at the ende of ech monthe.

ha_solar.title: Charge the bataille tonyght?
ha_solar.desc: At 21:00, weyeth tomorwes forecast of the sonne, the bataille degree and tonyghtes chepeste pris, and counseileth whether to charge fro the net. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_solar.tip: He oonly counseileth; adde a blok “calle” if thou wolt that he do it.

ha_heating_waste.title: Lokynge for hete wasted
ha_heating_waste.desc: Aspyeth hetynge rennynge with no wight at hoom, wyndowes open, or chambres heted fer above hir mark. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_heating_waste.tip: Renne it every two houres in wynter.

ha_damp.title: Wacche of moistnesse and mowlynge
ha_damp.desc: Loketh on two dayes of moistnesse in the bath chambre and the bedde chambre and yeveth counseil if a chambre dwelleth moist. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_damp.tip: Above 70% for longe whiles is whan mowlynge bigynneth.

ha_sleep.title: Bettre hete in the bedde chambre
ha_sleep.desc: Loketh on thre nyghtes of hete and moistnesse in the bedde chambre and profreth settynges of hetynge for bettre sleep. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.

ha_window.title: Wyndowe open, hetynge on
ha_window.desc: Whan the kichene wyndowe openeth whil the hetynge is on, counseileth to stinte the hetynge. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_window.tip: Chaunge binary_sensor.kitchen_window to off and than on in the table.

ha_co2.title: Warnynge of a close studie
ha_co2.desc: Every 30 minutes, if CO₂ in the studie be over 1200 ppm, counseileth to open a wyndowe. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_co2.tip: Above aboute 1000 ppm, the wit falleth as men may se.

ha_seasonal.title: Tempre the ordinaunce of hetynge
ha_seasonal.desc: Loketh on a wike of hetes and profreth chaunges to thyn ordinaunce of hetynge for the monthe that cometh. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_seasonal.tip: Renne it at the bigynnynge of ech monthe.

ha_water.title: Watre the gardyn today?
ha_water.desc: At 07:00, weyeth the moistnesse of the erthe, newe reyn and the forecast; if wateringe be nede it renneth the wateringe and telleth thee why. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_water.tip: Chaunge the wateringe swicche to thyn owene.

ha_frost.title: Warnynge of frost
ha_frost.desc: At 17:00, loketh on tonyghtes forecast and remembreth thee to covere tendre plauntes if frost be likly. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_frost.tip: Adde “and brynge the pottes in” to the message.

ha_plant.title: Nempne that plaunte
ha_plant.desc: Chese a portreiture of a plaunte; Claude nempneth it, yeveth counseils of kepynge, and addeth it to a remembred rolle of thy plauntes.
ha_plant.tip: Open Memorie after to se the rolle he hath bilt.

ha_greenhouse.title: Glas hous to hoot
ha_greenhouse.desc: Every 30 minutes, if the glas hous be over 26°C, remembreth thee to open the vent. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_greenhouse.tip: Lowe the bounde for yonge sprynges.

ha_proofing.title: Whan shal the dowgh be redy?
ha_proofing.desc: Telle hym at what degree thy dowgh is; he redeth the hete of risynge and gesseth whan it shal be redy. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_proofing.tip: Sette it on what so felere sitteth bisyde thy dowgh.

ha_bake.title: Ordinaunce of bakynge for todayes kichene
ha_bake.desc: Werketh bakward fro whan thou wolt breed out of the oven, shapynge every pas to thy kichenes verray hete. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_bake.tip: A warm kichene shorteth the firste risynge; he taketh heede therof.

ha_fridge.title: Wacche of coold cofre and frosen cofre
ha_fridge.desc: Every 30 minutes, warneth thee if the coold cofre ryse above 5°C or the frosen cofre above -15°C. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_fridge.tip: Chaunge a hete in the table to assaye the warnynge.

ha_starter.title: Remembraunce to fede the levain
ha_starter.desc: At 08:00, redeth the hete of the kichene and profreth whan to fede the levain today, and in what proporcioun. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_starter.tip: Seye thy wont proporcioun in the questioun.

ha_oven.title: Oven left brennynge
ha_oven.desc: Whan the laste wight goth out, loketh on the oven and sendeth an hasty warnynge if it be yet on. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_oven.tip: In the table, sette switch.oven to on, and than person.alex to not_home.

ha_dinner.title: What is for soper?
ha_dinner.desc: Profreth thre sopers fro that which is on thy rolle of byinge and in the kichene, with that thou woldest yet nede. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_dinner.tip: Useth Home Assistantes rolle of byinge.

ha_chores.title: An evene rolle of werkes
ha_chores.desc: Ech wike, write who dide what; he remembreth, and than writeth an evene rolle for the nexte wike. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_chores.tip: Renne it on Sonday at even with the meynee.

ha_laundry.title: The waisshynge is doon
ha_laundry.desc: Whan the myght of the waisshynge engyn falleth, he telleth thee that the waisshynge is ended. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_laundry.tip: In the table, chaunge the myght of the waisshynge engyn to 400 and than 2.

ha_dishwasher.title: Is the disshe wassher clene?
ha_dishwasher.desc: Answereth the questioun withouten ende fro the disshe wasshers estaat, in a frendly sentence. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_dishwasher.tip: Adde it to a botoun on a table or aske it by vois.

ha_bedtime.title: Tale for bedde on the spekere
ha_bedtime.desc: At 19:30, dimmeth the bedde chambres light and redeth a fresshe short tale for bedde on the spekere in the childrens chambre. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_bedtime.tip: Chaunge the childes name and delites in the requeste of the tale.

ha_checkin.title: A softe lokynge on a kynsman
ha_checkin.desc: At 10:00, if ther hath been no mevynge in the litel hous al the morwe, sendeth a softe “al wel?” to the meynee. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_checkin.tip: Acorde this with the wight first; it is his privetee eek.

ha_petcam.title: What dooth the hound?
ha_petcam.desc: Taketh an ymage fro the beestes camera and telleth thee, in a sentence, what thy beest is aboute. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_petcam.tip: Adde “and is he gnawynge any thyng that he sholde nat?”

ha_feeder.title: Wroghte the federe?
ha_feeder.desc: At 09:00, loketh that the federe yaf mete this morwe and whether the mete waxeth scant. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_feeder.tip: Sette the tyme to right after the federes ordinaunce.

ha_petheat.title: The beestes chambre to warm
ha_petheat.desc: Every 15 minutes, warneth thee if the chambre that thy beest is in go over 26°C. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_petheat.tip: Lowe it for kyndes with long heer.

ha_batteries.title: Batailles to chaunge
ha_batteries.desc: Fyndeth every bataille under 20% and turneth hem into a rolle of byinge sorted by chambre, with likly kyndes of bataille. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_batteries.tip: Renne it ones a monthe and thou shalt nevere be surprised by a deed felere.

ha_offline.title: What is gon out of knotte?
ha_offline.desc: Telleth every thyng that may nat be reched and profreth the likly cause and remedie for ech. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_offline.tip: Engynes in the shed and the carte hous fallen ofte awey whan it waxeth coold.

ha_maintenance.title: Kepynge that is due
ha_maintenance.desc: Redeth thy dayes of kepynge (boilere, warneres of smoke, siftes) and telleth what is overdue or due soone. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_maintenance.tip: Make an input_datetime helpere for ech werk in Home Assistant.

ha_leak.title: A lekynge!
ha_leak.desc: Whan a felere of lekynge is wet, sendeth an hasty warnynge and pronounceth the firste thynges to do. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_leak.tip: In the table, sette binary_sensor.leak_kitchen to on.

ha_waterflow.title: A droppynge tappe or an hid lekynge
ha_waterflow.desc: At 04:00, whan nothyng sholde renne, loketh on the mete of water and warneth thee of a smal flowynge that stinteth nevere. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_waterflow.tip: Werketh with any mete of water or felere of flowynge.

ha_servers.title: Hele of the servauntz in oon lyne
ha_servers.desc: Redeth thy Proxmox, disk and helper feleres and yeveth oon lyne in pleyn Englissh of how the werkhous at home fareth. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_servers.tip: Useth the Proxmox knottes feleres; shape it to thyne.

ha_pihole.title: Gaderynge of Pi-hole
ha_pihole.desc: A short gaderynge, esy to rede, of what Pi-hole lette today and whether any thyng semeth straunge. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.

ha_plex.title: What is newe on Plex
ha_plex.desc: At the wikes ende, a mery gaderynge of that which is added to Plex, with a cause of oon lyne to se ech. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.

ha_backups.title: Ronne the helperes?
ha_backups.desc: At 08:00, loketh on the helpyng copie of last nyght and sendeth an hasty warnynge if it failled. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_backups.tip: Sette it on what so felere thy werk of copies amendeth.

ha_netdigest.title: Gaderynge of the net
ha_netdigest.desc: A lokynge every wike on the net: newe engynes, Pi-hole, and the bisieste engynes, with any thyng worth lokynge on. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_netdigest.tip: Renne it on Sonday at morwe with thy coffee.

ha_rewrite_alerts.title: Turne rude warnynges into pleyn Englissh
ha_rewrite_alerts.desc: Paste an heep of rude warnynges; Claude joyneth the doubles and writeth hem agayn as a fewe cleer messages.
ha_rewrite_alerts.tip: Paste a morwes worth fro thy phone.

ha_tone.title: The right tone for the tyme of day
ha_tone.desc: Write a message; it is writen agayn to sute the houre (softe late at nyght, brisk at morwe) and sent. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_tone.tip: Assaye the same message at 7 at morwe and 11 at nyght.

ha_spoken.title: Morwe somme spoken
ha_spoken.desc: At 07:30 on werkdayes, speketh a somme of thritty secondes on the kichene spekere: weder, binnes, kalender and any thyng left open. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_spoken.tip: Sette HA_TTS_ENTITY in Python to thy servyce of text to speche.

ha_ignored.title: Sterner if it be nat herd
ha_ignored.desc: Sendeth a remembraunce, abideth, and if the bak dore be yet open, sendeth a sterner oon and seith it aloude. In the leef it useth the ensample hous, in the Python sent out thy verray Home Assistant.
ha_ignored.tip: In the table, shette the bak dore whil it abideth to se it stinte.
